title: How to earn commission with affiliate product data
summary: Monetize your AI or app with product recommendations. Use commission-ready product data to earn commission on sales you drive.
body_markdown:
If you're building an app or agent that recommends products, you can turn those recommendations into revenue. Commission-ready product data lets you surface real products with trackable links — when a user buys, you earn a commission. Here's how it works and what to look for.


## Why commission-ready product data?


Not all product APIs are commission-enabled. Some return product info but no monetizable links; others tie you to a single network or require per-brand signups. An API that combines broad product coverage with built-in commission rails means you integrate once and earn across many merchants.


## What you need


- **Attribution** — Links that track when a user came from your app and attribute the sale to you.
- **Coverage** — A large catalog so your recommendations are relevant and varied.
- **Simplicity** — One API, one relationship, no need to manage hundreds of commission programs.


## Use cases


Shopping assistants, gift finders, style advisors, and comparison tools can all surface product results with commission-earning links. When users click through and purchase, you earn. Channel3's catalog is commission-ready for most products via partnerships with major networks — so you can focus on the experience and let the data layer handle monetization.
